pretreatments.description: Mechanical pretreatment: Cutting ZS into 3–5 mm pieces before use.
2% KOH pretreatment: Mixing ZS with 2% KOH solution (mass concentration) for 24 h at room temperature, setting moisture content to 95%, and calculating weight ratios.
4% NaOH pretreatment: Mixing ZS with 4% NaOH solution (mass concentration) for 24 h at room temperature, setting moisture content to 95%, and calculating weight ratios.

4% AHP pretreatment: Adjusting the pH value of AHP solution to 11.5 by adding NaOH, mixing ZS with 4% AHP solution (mass concentration) for 24 h at room temperature, setting moisture content to 95%, and calculating weight ratios.
